o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish طَانِشْمَقْ (danışmaq), ultimately a derivation of Proto-Turkic *tanu- (“to know, get to know”), whence also Azerbaijani tanımaq. Cognate with Karakhanid تَنُشْماقْ (tanušmāq, “to talk to each other”), Ottoman Turkish طانشمق (danışmak, “to advise, counsel”).
